To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the incorporation of 20nm SiC nanoparticles into nickel electroplating modifies the impedance and polarization diagrams in correlation to the surface morphology and the crystallinity of the obtained nickel matrix.
the incorporation of SiC nanoparticles into the electrodeposit of nickel modifies the surface morphology and crystal structure of the nickel matrix.

the incorporation of silicon carbide (SiC) nanoparticles into the nickel plating bath modifies the impedance and the polarization curves, which is correlated with the surface morphology and the crystallinity of the deposited nickel layer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the SiC nanoparticles on the electroplating of nickel.
the development of a novel method of electrochemical synthesis of nanocomposite layers based on the incorporation of SiC particles into the nickel matrix by electroplating.
the influence of nanoparticles on the properties of the electroplated nickel matrix.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of the SiC nanoparticles in the electrolyte leads to the modification of the nickel electroplating process and to the formation of the nanostructured Ni–SiC layers.

the incorporation of nanoparticles in nickel matrix leads to a change in the mechanism of electrocrystallization and the growth of nickel crystals, which in turn results in a change of electrochemical properties of the electrodeposited nickel.
the presence of SiC nanoparticles in nickel deposition modifies the cathodic polarization diagrams and the electrochemical impedance spectra.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SiC particles are incorporated into the nickel matrix and the incorporation of nanoparticles is accompanied by an increase in the surface roughness.
the addition of nanoparticles to the electrolyte can be used to control the morphology of the deposited layer, and thus, the electrochemical properties of the electrodeposited nickel matrix.
SiC nanoparticles can be used for modification of the electroplating process of nickel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
incorporation of nanoparticles in nickel electroplating leads to a decrease of overpotential and a change of the mechanism of nickel deposition.
the addition of SiC nanoparticles into the electrolyte leads to the increase of nickel deposition rate and to the formation of nanocomposite layers with improved mechanical properties.
the incorporation of SiC nanoparticles into the nickel electroplating process can significantly change the properties of the obtained composite layers.
